name: postmcpai
description: Connect social accounts through PostMCP AI, create and schedule posts, and review post and profile analytics.

interface.longDescription: Manage connected social profiles, prepare and schedule posts, and inspect analytics across LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky and YouTube Shorts. Connect social accounts in the PostMCP dashboard. Supports per-user OAuth on the hosted server and API keys in compatible MCP clients.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect my social accounts to PostMCP AI.
Prepare and schedule a post for my connected accounts.
Show the performance of my recent posts.
